svg.title: Where the pretrained model enters the spam project
svg.desc: Data preparation is complete. Section 6.4 builds GPT-2 small and loads its learned weights. The classifier head, evaluation tools, training, and testing come later.

g.text: Download SMS messages, encode them, and build labeled batches.
§6.4 Build GPT-2 small → load pretrained weights
Try a prompt. “Every effort moves you” continues with “forward.”
Next in setup: add the spam classifier head and evaluation tools.
Train on labeled SMS, measure accuracy, then classify new messages.
